name: Banana Leaf Black Sigatoka
symptoms: early_stage: Tiny reddish or rusty-brown flecks on the underside of banana leaves Small streaks parallel to leaf veins intermediate_stage: Streaks elongate and darken into reddish-brown or black lines Lesions become visible on both sides of the leaf advanced_stage: Oval-shaped lesions with grey centers Yellow halos surrounding lesions Large necrotic areas causing leaf death
management: cultural_control: Removal of infected leaves Improving field drainage Reducing humidity around plants Planting resistant banana varieties chemical_control: Triazole fungicides Demethylation inhibitor fungicides Methyl benzimidazole carbamates (MBC) biological_or_genetic_control: Breeding resistant banana cultivars Genetically modified resistant banana varieties
sources: Biosecurity Queensland – Black Sigatoka pest profile
Cook et al., 2013. Crop Protection Journal
